speaker: abel_garnish
text: You are here at the hour you set, and not before it. The two stops from Thursday are in the book, where you crossed the roll.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the book has them. I will not move a third because a morning is idle.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I walked it in the garret, Master Will. The breath holds to the end of the clause. I am not going to say the speech out to prove it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Good. A pint does not improve by being spent again before dinner. Thou mayst stand down, Nick. The old book is this morning's work.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: The old book, and the Sins at two. I am in them. I have not come to learn a new king's entrance before I have played the one the yard already knows.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I have not come to ask you for a jig, or for a line you will be sorry you gave me. We are civil this morning, Will, and I intend to remain so.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we are civil. I will not write your laughs into anything, and I will not open a tally for a joke that has not been made.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Costard can wait in the corner of a scene he is not in yet. I know when to come in. I do not need the coming-in written up as if I had already done it wrong.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the letter in your hand when you come in, and not before. Today we are not in that scene. Today is the book the yard knows.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then give me the old cues, Abel, and spare me a new statute. Seventeen days are seventeen days. They are not this afternoon.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot for this afternoon is the plot we used before Christmas. No new side. Nothing was bought.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The songs stay as Tuesday left them. One stop in the owl. No word. Sam copied Thursday's two sitting down, which is enough victory for a week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let Nick's speech rest. I moved two stops. I am not fetching him back to spend them for a room that has already heard the difference.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will go and eat, if I am not called.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Go and eat. A boy who stays to be useful spends the breath I just saved.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And leave the watchet taffeta out of this room. John has the mercer. I will not stand here and turn a gown into my business.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gown is fifty shillings, unpaid, and it is not mine to settle between cues. John has it. This room does not.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Good. I will not hear a price while I am trying to remember an entrance I have known since the frost. Walk the old book, Abel.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: We walk what shakes at the door, and we stop when those are walked. I will not find an extra fault so the morning feels long.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then walk them. The letter is on the road. The head I have brought is a player's head.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You are here. That will do. A pulpit is a different house, and this is not one.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Sam is not fetched. Nick is gone to his bread. The rest of you, the old cues, and then the yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The new comedy stays in the rolls. Not in front of a yard. Not this morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then stop talking about it, Will, and give me the door I already know.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The door is yours. I am done inventing mornings.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I can love a morning that knows what it is. Shall we walk?
